description: This source file is a command-line tool for processing and generating C++ header files from a root certificate store protobuf, including reading, decoding, and writing certificate data, with specific focus on Chrome root certificates and EV root metadata.

methods.name: DecodeCerts
methods.description: Decodes PEM-encoded certificates into a map from SHA-256 hex hash to DER certificate data.

methods.name: ReadTextRootStore
methods.description: Reads and parses a root store protobuf from text format, optionally decoding associated certificates from a separate file.

methods.name: WriteRootCppFile
methods.description: Generates a C++ header file with embedded root certificate data.

methods.name: WriteEvCppFile
methods.description: Generates a C++ header file with embedded EV root CA metadata.
